chapter: Idaho tours, Music Town and retirement
title: Touring Idaho by van
summary: The band was carried by van from Salt Lake to Boise each year; the poster picture was not the road band.

bands.name: Reb Spikes and His Majors and Minors Orchestra

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Back to this Kimberly, Iowa: You brought out this marvelous poster...

We played all over Idaho for this...after we played the Kimberly. That was the men that hired us but they had a ...like these vans, you know, these vans they got now--everybody's got 'em. They had 'em with eight or ten seats and they...we...they carried us by van all over, you know, from Salt Lake to Boise--all along there we'd play each year.
Could you get all those instruments [shown on the poster] in there?
Well, you know, they pile them on top. It was a regular bus, about twelve or fourteen seats in it. It wasn't one of these sleepers or nothing. It had seats in it.
'Cause there's a lot of instruments here. I mean, there's what--one, two, three, four...
Well, that wasn't the band we carried on the road. That was the band that I made the pictures with, so I had that big cut, and I used it.
